Hard to say, https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquibot/issues/729

Original [discussion](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/discussions/730)
Right now we use the diamond proxy pattern for most of our contracts (implemented as diamond [facets](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/tree/development/packages/contracts/src/dollar/facets)).
We also have the [core](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/tree/development/packages/contracts/src/dollar/core) contracts that can't be used with the diamond proxy because of function clashing. Hence the different upgradability pattern should be used.
What should be done:
1. Apply UUPS to the core contracts:
- https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/blob/development/packages/contracts/src/dollar/core/CreditNft.sol
- https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/blob/development/packages/contracts/src/dollar/core/ERC1155Ubiquity.sol
- https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/blob/development/packages/contracts/src/dollar/core/ERC20Ubiquity.sol
- https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/blob/development/packages/contracts/src/dollar/core/StakingShare.sol
- https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/blob/development/packages/contracts/src/dollar/core/UbiquityCreditToken.sol
- https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/blob/development/packages/contracts/src/dollar/core/UbiquityDollarToken.sol
- https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/blob/development/packages/contracts/src/dollar/core/UbiquityGovernanceToken.sol
2. Update [deployment script](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/tree/development/packages/contracts/scripts/deploy/dollar/solidityScripting) accordingly
3. Refactor [tests](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/tree/development/packages/contracts/test/dollar/core) for core contracts accordingly
P.S. Although [CreditClock](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/blob/development/packages/contracts/src/dollar/core/CreditClock.sol) exists in the "core" folder it is not a "core" contract. We have [plans](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/issues/772) for moving it to diamond facets.

The original spec is implemented, core contracts are upgradeable
This PR still needs some refactoring (small changes in naming) but I will update it in a separate PR since those changes are not really connected with the UUPS
The "Compare test coverage" workflow is failing but since the current PR does not introduce new features I think it's ok to neglect the failing CI run
This contract inherits from `ERC1967Proxy` but doesn't override anything. Why can't we use `ERC1967Proxy` everywhere instead of `UupsProxy`?

We have a convention to omit all token symbols like `UAD, UCR, UGOV, etc...`
Whenever possible they should be referenced like `dollarToken`, `creditToken`, `creditNft`, `governanceToken`, etc...
Pls refactor accordingly
Pls remove the commented code across the whole PR

All core contracts and diamond facets should have proper natspec comments for constructors, state variables, methods, etc...
This way in the end we get natspec generated [docs](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/blob/development/packages/contracts/docs/src/SUMMARY.md)
Missing natspec comments for events
@Keyrxng Is it ready for review?
Pls mark the PR as ready for review when it is ready + make sure that CI is passing

Slither workflow is running against a PR branch. The `UupstestHelper.sol` file had never existed in the project before this PR was created.
Pls mark this PR as "ready for review" when you're done
